personalInfo.professionalSummary: Innovative, visionary, and results-driven iOS & Mobile Application Developer with over 10 years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering high-impact mobile solutions. I specialize in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, building elegant, scalable, and high-performance applications, with strong experience in Flutter for cross-platform delivery across iOS and Android from a single maintainable codebase. My approach blends technical mastery with creative problem-solving, ensuring every product is scalable, intuitive, and aligned with business goals.
highlights: Expert-level proficiency in Swift, SwiftUI, Flutter, Dart and mobile architecture
Strong eye for UI/UX design, performance optimisation, and accessibility
Proven leadership in cross-functional teams and client-facing roles
Deep integration experience with REST APIs, Firebase, and third-party SDKs
Agile mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement
personalInfo.professionalDevelopmentSummary:
This portfolio reflects over a decade of unwavering dedication to mobile application development, marked by deep technical expertise, strategic innovation, and consistent delivery of enterprise-grade solutions. My career trajectory showcases a dynamic evolution—from a hands-on developer to a trusted technical leader—with a proven ability to drive complex projects from concept to launch.

I’ve successfully engineered and delivered transformative mobile experiences for industry-leading clients such as Liverpool (Mexico), Walmart, DHL, and Cognizant, spanning diverse sectors including retail, healthcare, and fintech. My journey is defined by a commitment to excellence, continuous learning, and a passion for building scalable, user-centric applications that solve real-world problems.

projects.title: Click & Collect
projects.overview: The platform that allows users to buy products in-store or online and pick them up at the Liverpool store of choice, being the most convenient way to receive purchases according to users availability.
features: Click & Collect appointments: Skip the lines! Schedule an appointment to pick up your order at participating stores via confirmation email or My Purchases and save time.
Pick up in your car: Receive your purchases from the comfort of your car (depending on service availability).
Activate Flash: Choose Express Pickup to collect in two hours or Express Delivery to receive on the same day.
Pick up in 2 hours or same day of purchase in store: Collection time assigned after payment processing with email notification.

projects.title: Liverpool: Shop online iOS
projects.overview: Official iOS shopping application for Liverpool, one of Mexico’s largest department stores. Designed exclusively for iPhone, this app enables users to securely browse, discover, and purchase a wide range of products—from fashion and electronics to home goods—directly from their device. It delivers a seamless mobile shopping experience that integrates key retail services such as free shipping, in-store pickup, and comprehensive account management features.
features: Secure & Intuitive Shopping – Explore thousands of products across categories and brands with clean navigation.
Free Shipping – Offers free shipping on eligible purchases straight to the user’s location.
Click & Collect – Customers can order online and pick up at the nearest store for added convenience.
Easy Returns (Garantía Liverpool) – Built-in support for returns and guarantees to enhance customer satisfaction.
Wishlist & Notifications – Save favorites and receive push notifications for exclusive sales (Buen Fin, Hot Sale, Cyber Monday).
Wide Product Variety – Fashion, technology brands (Apple, Samsung, Nintendo), home essentials, and more.

projects.title: SDS Slot Delivery Scheduler App
projects.overview: Innovative delivery slot scheduling application designed to eliminate congestion at retail stores and optimize vendor deliveries across Walmart internal systems.
features: Vendors: Browse available delivery slots, book appointments, and receive real-time notifications.
Store Managers: Comprehensive visibility into scheduled deliveries, monitor real-time delivery flow.
Impact: Successfully deployed across Walmart’s internal systems, significantly reducing wait times and eliminating scheduling conflicts.
